prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production bitmap game asset for the approved Abyss Walker isometric cartoon fantasy RPG. Reference image is ONLY the approved hand-painted style and camera, not a target screenshot. Rounded chunky large forms, softly dark outlines, broad painted color planes, restrained highlights, upper-left diffuse daylight. No text, letters, numbers, UI, people, watermark, glow, vignette, diffuse background haze, scenic backdrop or cast shadow. For object sprites use exact orthographic isometric camera with ground-axis vectors (32,18) and (-32,18), full uncropped object with 12% transparent margin, centered grounded foot. For ground textures use flat overhead camera and full-bleed evenly lit square texture with low contrast, no perspective or borders. Palette/material direction: warm copper, charcoal gray, muted orange and teal glass. Primary request: one small civilian timber-and-cream-stone cottage with a broad low roof, one door and two windows, distinct from a military outpost. ONE isolated transparent sprite. Genuine clean alpha, no ground patch or shadow. Readable at 220px display width.
